title: From Phoebe Bridgers to Sombr, Which New Music Release Is Your Favorite This Week? Vote!
summary: Gracie Abrams, Steve Lacy and SZA are also back with new tracks.
contentText:
This year, June is ending with a particularly stacked slate of new music releases, thanks to musicians such as Phoebe Bridgers , Sombr and more.

Related

Drake Is Hosting Apology Parties for Anyone Named Janice in Several Cities: 'Look Out for My Invitation'

On Friday (June 26), the Boygenius band member finally released her first piece of new solo music in six years, dropping single “Lost Boys” ahead of her recently announced album Lost Weekend . The relaxed-tempo track finds Bridgers — who premiered the song live on her series of secret pop-up performances earlier in the year — examining the type of unmoored man she tends to attract, often finding herself as the person who gets left.

Continuing his run of strong singles, Sombr has followed up “Homewrecker” and “Potential” with new track “My Body Isn’t Ready,” one of his most personal confessionals to date as he laments feeling too insecure in his physique to be intimate with someone else.

Also new on streaming services on the tail end of June are tracks by Steve Lacy and SZA — who teamed up on duet “Is It Cool?” — and Gracie Abrams, whose single “Look at My Life” marks the second taste of upcoming third album Daughter From Hell fans have gotten. Plus, Katy Perry breaks free from her past on “Watch It Burn,” while Axwell teams up with Bonn on “Whatever Turns You On,” Cobrah joins forces with Grimes on “Sign From God,” and TEEKS shares “My Boy” as KWN drops the EP And All Pride Aside.

That’s a lot of new music to choose from, but Billboard still wants to know your favorite. Vote for the release you’re most excited by in the poll below.
